Interface IProjectTargetApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @ThreadSafe
public interface IProjectTargetApi

      • getAvailableCompilers

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<ImplementationProperty> getAvailableCompilers()
        getAvailableCompilers() returns all possible input values for setCompiler(ImplementationProperty).
        Available Compilers
        getAvailableCompilers() returns all possible input values for setCompiler(ImplementationProperty). Note: the available compilers depend on the currently configured derivative. This method will return an empty collection if no derivative has been configured at the time it is called.
        Returns:
        all available ImplementationPropertys of type EImplementationProperties.COMPILER

      • getAvailableDerivatives

        getAvailableDerivatives() returns all possible input values for setDerivative(DerivativeInfo).
        Returns:
        all available DerivativeInfos

      • getAvailableDerivatives

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<DerivativeInfo> getAvailableDerivatives(java.lang.String module)
        getAvailableDerivatives(String) returns all possible input values for setDerivative(String, DerivativeInfo).
        Module
        The module which supported Derivatives shall be retrieved.
        Available Derivatives
        getAvailableDerivatives(String) returns all possible input values for setDerivative(String, DerivativeInfo). Note: This function will return value of getAvailableDerivatives() if module is not hardware-specific.
        Returns:
        all available DerivativeInfos

      • getAvailablePinLayouts

        @PublishedMethod
java.util.Collection<ImplementationProperty> getAvailablePinLayouts()
        getAvailablePinLayouts() returns all possible input values for setPinLayout(ImplementationProperty).
        Available PinLayouts
        getAvailablePinLayouts() returns all possible input values for setPinLayout(ImplementationProperty). Note: The available pin layouts depend on the currently configured derivative. This method will return a empty collection if no derivative has been configured at the time it is called.
        Returns:
        all available ImplementationPropertys of type EImplementationProperties.PINLAYOUT

        @PublishedMethod
DerivativeInfo getDerivative(java.lang.String module)
        getDerivative(String) returns the derivative set for specific module.

        The module which derivative setting shall be retrieved.
        Get Derivative

        Set the compiler for the new project with setCompiler(ImplementationProperty). The value given here must be one of the values returned by getAvailableCompilers().
